decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is a multi-model consumable line at the core of the formwork offer, so it likely stays despite not being observed on the website in 2020-2021.
Automated concrete distributor flow control supports the firm's automation strategy and is probably integrated into its plant solutions rather than marketed as a standalone item.
Magnetic formwork strips with several models are a staple of precast production, and the firm will keep them as part of its integrated formwork range.
The single magnetic formwork component overlaps with similar items, and its sibling F was already withdrawn, but it costs little to maintain and complements the range.
